tasks.subject: Task 1: 24h window ring + WindowCounts()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `obsMetrics` counts requests into 288 five-minute buckets; `Client.WindowCounts()` reports trailing 6h/12h/24h totals.

**Files:**
- Modify: `internal/obs/client.go` (obsMetrics struct, inc, new methods)
- Modify: `internal/obs/metrics_test.go` (append tests)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 11h hits count toward 12h+24h not 6h; 23h only 24h; 24h+5m none
- [ ] Bucket reused exactly 24h later is zeroed first
- [ ] Zero traffic -> all windows 0
- [ ] go test ./internal/obs/ -count=1 passes

**Verify:** `cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestWindowCounts -count=1 -v` -> all PASS

**Steps:** TDD, full code in plan Task 1. Commit: git commit -s, never Co-Authored-By.

tasks.subject: Task 3: MetricsPanel frontend
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The collapsed panel at the bottom of the Overview tab, polling `/api/metrics` every 30s while expanded, rendering the mockup-A layout.

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/src/types/metrics.ts`
- Create: `frontend/src/composables/useMetrics.ts`
- Create: `frontend/src/components/MetricsPanel.vue`
- Modify: `frontend/src/components/OverviewPanel.vue` (import + one tag after CveExposureTable)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Collapsed by default; header toggles
- [ ] Poll only while expanded: immediate fetch + 30s interval, cleared on collapse/unmount
- [ ] Three groups (OBS total/rate/windows; limiter meter or disabled; working-set chips) + sorted two-column endpoint table (empty state)
- [ ] updated-age label; error line with stale data still rendered
- [ ] npm run build exits 0

**Verify:** `cd frontend && npm run build` -> vue-tsc no errors, exit 0

**Steps:** full code in plan Task 3. Commit: git commit -s, never Co-Authored-By.
